citation: Shahrad et al., Serverless in the Wild: Characterizing and Optimizing the Serverless Workload at a Large Cloud Provider, USENIX ATC 2020
content: Requests per minute per app (sum of its HTTP-triggered functions), 14 days, minute 0 = day 1 00:00
selection: HTTP traffic on all 14 days, mean >= 500 requests/minute, coefficient of variation >= 0.15, < 5% zero minutes, exact duplicates removed
